Give a level-4 beacon the **No Fly** effect and elytra stop working inside its range. Takeoff is refused, and anyone who glides in from outside has their wings cut — no gentle landing. Riptide tridents and firework boosts are blocked too. Enforcement is entirely server-side; vanilla clients are fully affected and need no mod.

See https://github.com/tomgidden/minecraft-noflyzone/releases/tag/${VERSION}
